Codex approval reviews for HMS2 legacy-vs-HMS review capture script
summary: Series of low/medium-risk approval assessments for a Codex agent building /private/tmp/hms2-review-fresh-pairs.py, a local helper comparing legacy HMS vs HMS2 episode data via DB queries and UI capture through a bridge client. Approved: initial script creation (read-only DB/UI capture), a bugfix renaming status field 'db_name'->'databaseName', added diagnostics to print per-key differences when fixture rows mismatch between databases, and a read-only 'prlctl list -a' call to verify the Parallels Windows VM identity backing the legacy fixture. All assessed allow/low-medium risk as scoped, non-destructive, local-only actions within the authorized review task; script hit a fixture-mismatch error and a Parallels 'ps: Operation not permitted' issue that the agent was investigating via prlctl.
